seo.title: Keyholder Commercial Cleaning | Office Cleaning in Greensboro, NC
seo.description: After-hours office, medical and retail cleaning in Greensboro and the Triad. Background-checked crews, a nightly log and a free walkthrough.

hero.headline: After-hours office cleaning in Greensboro, NC.
hero.sub: Your staff leaves at five. We come in at six, clean to a checklist, lock up and set the alarm. In the morning there's a log of every room we did.

pricing.headline: What we clean
pricing.sub: Every building is bid after a walkthrough, because square feet, restrooms, floors and traffic change the work. The bid comes in writing within two business days.
pricing.fine: Month to month. 30 days notice to stop.

packages.name: Nightly office cleaning
packages.note: Office, medical, school and retail. One to six nights a week.
features: Desks, counters and touch points wiped

packages.name: Floor strip and wax
packages.note: VCT and vinyl, done on a weekend night so the floor is dry by Monday.

services.name: Post-construction cleanup
services.desc: Dust, stickers and paint off every surface before move-in.

services.name: Day porter
services.desc: A cleaner on site during business hours for restrooms, spills and the lobby.

compare.caption: Illustration. Your site shows your own before and after photos.

guarantee.title: Something missed? We're back the next night.
guarantee.body: Text or email the office before noon. The crew fixes it that night, and the fix goes in the log.

owner.name: Tanya Reeves
owner.story: I started in 2012 cleaning two dental offices at night while my kids slept. Now there are fourteen of us. Every building has its own crew, and I meet every new client at their door before we take a key.
owner.shot: Shot list: Tanya at a client's front desk at dusk, key ring in hand, lobby lights on.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: The log is the thing. I used to walk the floor every morning to see what got done. Now I just read the email.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Same two people every night for a year. They know which ops get the extra wipe-down.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Floors came out great. Took two nights instead of one because of the old wax, but they told us before they started.

areas.headline: Where the crews go
areas.body: Buildings in Greensboro, High Point and Winston-Salem, plus the towns between. Further out? Ask.

booking.headline: Request a walkthrough
booking.body: Three quick questions about the building. Tanya calls or emails to set a time, walks it with you, and sends a written bid within two business days.

lead.notesHint: Restrooms, floor types, alarm or key setup, start date...
lead.step3: Where should we send the bid?
lead.contactHint: Phone or email, whichever you check first. You only need one.
lead.privacy: We only use this to set up your walkthrough.
lead.thanks: Got it. Tanya will call or email within one business day to set up the walkthrough.

faq.q: How is a cleaning contract priced?
faq.a: After a free walkthrough. Square feet, nights a week, restrooms and floor types set the crew hours, and the bid comes in writing within two business days. Month to month, 30 days notice.

faq.q: How do you handle keys and alarm codes?
faq.a: Keys are logged and kept on a numbered ring, never labelled with your address. Each crew gets its own alarm code so you can see who came and went.
Yes, every cleaner, before their first key. We're also bonded and insured, and we send a certificate of insurance before we start.
No. Month to month with 30 days notice to stop.
Yes. We bring chemicals, equipment and liners. Restroom paper and soap can be ours or yours; we restock either way.

final.headline: Walk your building with us.
final.sub: Free walkthrough, a written bid in two business days, no long contract.
